changes_data.diff:
@@ -90,12 +90,12 @@ dfilter_expand(const char *expr, df_error_t **err_ret);
  */
 WS_DLL_PUBLIC
 gboolean
-dfilter_compile_real(const gchar *text, dfilter_t **dfp,
+dfilter_compile_full(const gchar *text, dfilter_t **dfp,
 			df_error_t **errpp, unsigned flags,
 			const char *caller);
 
 #define dfilter_compile(text, dfp, errp) \
-	dfilter_compile_real(text, dfp, errp, \
+	dfilter_compile_full(text, dfp, errp, \
 				DF_EXPAND_MACROS|DF_OPTIMIZE, \
 				__func__)

commits_data.title: dfilter: Rename dfilter_compile_real() -> dfilter_compile_full()
commits_data.message:
dfilter: Rename dfilter_compile_real() -> dfilter_compile_full()

The function is part of the public interface. The new name is better
and more descriptive.

commits_data.title: dfilter: Move flags to dfwork_t
commits_data.message:
dfilter: Move flags to dfwork_t

Replace booleans with a flags field.

commits_data.title: dfilter: Add a dfwork_parse() function
commits_data.message:
dfilter: Add a dfwork_parse() function

Split the scanning/parsing stage into a separate function to
improve the structure of the code.

commits_data.title: dfilter: Normalize error handling
commits_data.message:
dfilter: Normalize error handling

Fail compilation if error pointer is set. Remove other redundant
failure flags.

Remove lemon %parse_failure block. This should be unnecessary.
I think this is only useful if we are doing error recovery,
which we aren't.

commits_data.title: dfilter: Rename struct member
commits_data.message:
dfilter: Rename struct member

Members inside a structure do not need a namespace
prefix.

Remove stale declaration.

commits_data.title: dfilter: Remove a default case statement
commits_data.message:
dfilter: Remove a default case statement

Let a (good) compiler warn if there is a missing case
in the switch.
